tools.name: contracts_ending
tools.description:
UK public-sector software/IT contracts whose end date falls between ends_from and ends_to,
    soonest first. Use it to find rebid and renewal opportunities. Awards whose notice gives no end
    date are left out; coverage_info says how many that is.

tools.name: search_awards
supplier_history
tools.description:
Every software/IT award won by a supplier: count, total value, the buyers it wins from most,
    its contracts that end next, and its latest awards.

tools.name: buyer_history
tools.description:
Every software/IT award made by a public body, e.g. 'Leeds Teaching Hospitals': count, total
    value, the suppliers it uses most, its contracts that end next, and its latest awards.

tools.name: coverage_info
tools.description: What the data covers: date range, number of awards, how many have an end date or a value, sources and licence. Takes no arguments.
